body.p: Two camps met each other. In both of them there were two [= one each] girl. One camp was of ogres, the other one was of humans. In both of them there were two [= one each] boys. They got married exchanging their older sisters. On the next day they separated. The ogres started shamanizing after having wandered one stage. They wanted to sacrifice the woman. The woman guessed that they wanted to sacrifice her. The woman said: "Let me go out". They let her out. The woman climbed onto a bent tree, onto a pine. Their shaman said: "Kill the sacrifice". An ogre said: "Our sacrifice is not there". There the ogres began to search with kindlings for their sacrifice, they couldn't find their sacrifice. They let [it] until dawn, until the sun rose. In the morning they started searching, they went as a pair along the way. The woman came to her brother. When she had reached her brother, they wandered on by night. They crossed a frozen river. They crossed it and chopped the ice on their trace. When the ogres were crossing the river, they drowned in the icehole.
